fullPassage: Our emotions are thought to exist because they have contributed to our survival as a species. Fear has helped us avoid dangers, expressing anger helps us scare off threats, and expressing positive emotions helps us bond with others. From an evolutionary perspective, an emotion is a kind of "program" that, when triggered, directs many of our activities (including attention, perception, memory, movement, expressions, etc.). For example, fear makes us very attentive, narrows our perceptual focus to threatening stimuli, will cause us either to face a situation (fight) or avoid it (flight), and may cause us to remember an experience more acutely (so that we avoid the threat in the future). Regardless of the specific ways in which they activate our systems, the specific emotions we possess are thought to exist because they have helped us (as a species) survive challenges within our environment long ago. If they had not helped us adapt and survive, they would not have evolved with us.

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 face의 의미로 가장 적절하게 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 정답은 (A) 직면하다 — (B) 얼굴 이다.
det.analysis:
① (A) 얼굴: 위험에 '직면하다'가 자연스러워 부적절
② (B) 표면: 두려움이 드러난 '얼굴'이 자연스러워 부적절
③ (A) 직면하다 — (B) 얼굴 ←정답: (A)는 위험에 맞서다, (B)는 감정이 드러난 얼굴
④ (A) 향하다: 위험에 맞선다는 맥락이므로 부적절
det.tip: face는 '직면하다'와 '얼굴' 등 여러 뜻을 가진다.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a group of living things that are similar and can produce young together"

det.korean: 정답은 species(종)이다.
det.analysis:
① environment(환경): 생물을 둘러싼 조건으로 정의와 다름
② species(종) ←정답: 서로 비슷하고 함께 번식할 수 있는 생물 집단
③ memory(기억): 정보를 저장·회상하는 능력으로 정의와 다름
④ threat(위협): 해를 끼칠 수 있는 대상으로 정의와 다름
det.tip: '번식 가능한 비슷한 생물 집단'이라는 정의의 핵심을 파악한다.

questions.passage: Our emotions are thought to exist because they have __________ (contribute) to our survival as a species. Fear has helped us avoid dangers, expressing anger helps us scare off threats, and expressing positive emotions helps us bond with others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 영어로 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: have 뒤에서 현재완료를 이루므로 과거분사 contributed가 되어야 한다.
det.analysis: 동사 contribute를 have와 함께 현재완료(have contributed)로 쓰기 위해 과거분사 contributed로 변형한다.
det.tip: have + 과거분사(현재완료) 구조를 확인한다.

questions.passage: From an evolutionary perspective, an emotion is a kind of "program" that, when triggered, directs many of our activities. For example, fear makes us very attentive, __________ (narrow) our perceptual focus to threatening stimuli, and may cause us to remember an experience more acutely.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 영어로 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: 주어 fear에 이어지는 동사이므로 3인칭 단수 현재형 narrows가 되어야 한다.
det.analysis: 주어 fear에 대응하는 병렬 동사이므로 동사 narrow에 -s를 붙여 3인칭 단수 현재형 narrows로 변형한다.
det.tip: 주어가 3인칭 단수(fear)이면 현재형 동사에 -s를 붙인다.

questions.passage: Our emotions are thought to exist because they have contributed to our survival as a species. Fear has helped us avoid dangers, expressing anger helps us scare off threats, and expressing positive emotions helps us __________. From an evolutionary perspective, an emotion is a kind of "program" that, when triggered, directs many of our activities (including attention, perception, memory, movement, expressions, etc.). For example, fear makes us very attentive, narrows our perceptual focus to threatening stimuli, will cause us either to face a situation (fight) or avoid it (flight), and may cause us to remember an experience more acutely (so that we avoid the threat in the future). Regardless of the specific ways in which they activate our systems, the specific emotions we possess are thought to exist because they have helped us (as a species) survive challenges within our environment long ago. If they had not helped us adapt and survive, they would not have evolved with us.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 긍정적 감정을 표현하는 것은 우리가 '타인과 유대를 맺도록(bond with others)' 돕는다.
det.analysis:
① avoid danger alone(혼자 위험을 피하다): 유대와 무관
② remember the threat(위협을 기억하다): 문맥과 무관
③ face the situation(상황에 맞서다): 두려움의 기능이므로 부적절
④ bond with others(타인과 유대를 맺다) ←정답: 긍정적 감정의 사회적 기능
det.tip: 긍정적 감정이 사회적 관계에 주는 효과를 파악한다.

questions.passage: Our emotions are thought to exist because they have contributed to our survival as a species. Fear has helped us avoid dangers, expressing anger helps us scare off threats, and expressing positive emotions helps us bond with others. From an evolutionary perspective, an emotion is a kind of "program" that, when triggered, directs many of our activities (including attention, perception, memory, movement, expressions, etc.). For example, fear makes us very attentive, narrows our perceptual focus to threatening stimuli, will cause us either to face a situation (fight) or avoid it (flight), and may cause us to remember an experience more acutely (so that we __________ in the future). Regardless of the specific ways in which they activate our systems, the specific emotions we possess are thought to exist because they have helped us (as a species) survive challenges within our environment long ago. If they had not helped us adapt and survive, they would not have evolved with us.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 경험을 예리하게 기억하는 것은 미래에 '위협을 피하기(avoid the threat)' 위해서이다.
det.analysis:
① avoid the threat(위협을 피하다) ←정답: 경험을 더 잘 기억하는 목적이 미래의 위협 회피임
② face the danger(위험에 맞서다): 기억의 목적과 어긋남
③ forget the past(과거를 잊다): 문맥과 반대
④ scare the enemy(적을 겁주다): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: 괄호 속 'so that ...'가 기억의 목적을 설명함을 파악한다.
